Name: Muscovy Ducks for Stardew Valley
Author: JustANorm4lGirl0
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[size=3][color=#D4D4D8]This mods adds five new duck variants to the game — the [u]Muscovies[/u]! It adds [b]White Muscovy, Grey Muscovy, Chocolate Muscovy, Black Muscovy and Wild Muscovy![/b][/color][/size]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]First, have installed [b]Simple Animal Variants[/b] by [b]PureWinter [/b]into [b]Stardew Valley mods folder[/b] then, extract [b]Muscovy Ducks [/b]and copy [b]PUT ALL SKINS HERE [/b]folder and paste it into [b]Simple Animal Variants [/b]folder, now, replace [b]Simple Animal Variants' PUT ALL SKINS HERE[/b] by my folder with same name.[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8]Now it will work perfectly![/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]Adds five muscovy variants:[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8][b]There are five muscovies variants:[/b][/color]
[color=#d4d4d8][b]White Muscovy- [/b]Adds a white muscovy, which is all white, inspired by my other muscovy, Banana (because when baby she was all yellow)[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8][b]Grey Muscovy- [/b]Adds a grey muscovy which is inspired by my muscovy, Quenquem, with a lot shades of gray (she was the hardest one)[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8][b]Chocolate Muscovy- [/b]Adds a chocolate muscovy, which is a chocolate brown, inspired by a muscovy I had, Doralice[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8][b]Black Muscovy- [/b]Adds a black muscovy, which have all their feathers black, inspired by a muscovy I had, Pretinha[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8][b]Wild Muscovy-  [/b]Adds a wild muscovy, which is black with iridescent feathers on the wings and tail, and some black parts on the caruncle (the red spot around their face) and brown eyes, inspired by a wild muscovy that came and mated with my drake, and laid the egg that Quenquem was born.[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8][b]They have different duckling color too![/b][/color]
[color=#d4d4d8][b]Baby White Muscovy- [/b]are all yellow with brown eyes (since newborn ducklings have brown eyes, even that some days after their hatch, their eyes become blue and then cyan, when they reach 3-4 months old), have pink feet[/color]

[color=#d4d4d8][b]Baby Grey Muscovy- [/b]are mostly yellow, with only the tip of the tail being black, have purple beak and feet, inspired by Quenquem, when she was a duckling[/color]

[b]Baby Chocolate Muscovy- [/b]half of their body is brown and the other half is yellow and have purple beak and feet

[b]Baby Black and Wild Muscovies-[/b] half of their body are black and the other half are yellow, both have purple beak and feet.

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8][b]Install Simple Animal Variants by PureWinter so the mod will work[/b].[/color]
[color=#d4d4d8]If you want your muscovies to swim, install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15860]Like A Duck To Water[/url] mod that allows your ducks to swim[/color]

[size=4][b]Shout outs[/b][/size]
[color=#d4d4d8]Thank you [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/PureWinter/mods]PureWinter[/url] by showing me your mod so my mod could work.[/color]
